name: GPU Voxelization
definition: A GPU-based voxelization pipeline using a vertex, geometry, and fragment shader to rasterize triangles into a voxel list. It uses atomic counters to handle concurrent writes.
summary: GPU Voxelization converts triangle meshes into voxel grids by leveraging hardware rasterization to map fragments directly to 3D grid cells, offering a high-performance alternative to CPU-based ray tracing.
